stages.title: 1. Minutes
stages.note: Projected minutes distribution (incl. DNP mass).

stages.title: 2. Possessions
stages.note: Expected on-court possessions = k x pace x minutes / 48.

stages.title: 3. Shot attempts
stages.note: Attempts per possession x possessions, adjusted for opponent and teammates.

stages.title: 4. Shot-type split
stages.note: FGA split into 3PA and 2PA.

stages.title: 5. Efficiency
stages.note: Make probabilities by shot type (shrunk talent).

stages.title: 6. Distribution
stages.note: Simulate attempts and makes -> points distribution -> P(over/under).

REB.mvp_fallback: EXP_REB_BASELINE = REB%_hat x (MIN/48) x total rebounds expected from ENV_EXP_MISSED_SHOTS (no tracking needed)

stages.title: 0. MVP baseline (no tracking)
stages.note: Rate-based projection; the opportunity pipeline below must beat it in ablation.

stages.title: 1. Minutes
stages.note: Projected minutes.

stages.title: 2. Rebound supply
stages.note: Expected missed shots of both teams (supply); history reconciles with total rebounds.

stages.title: 3. Opportunity share
stages.note: Share of the available misses the player is positioned to contest, given who else is on the floor.

stages.title: 4. Rebound chances
stages.note: Expected chances = misses during his minutes x share.

stages.title: 5. Conversion
stages.note: Rebounds per chance (shrunk).

stages.title: 6. Distribution
stages.note: Negative-binomial rebounds given overdispersed chances (conversion can marginally exceed 1).

AST.mvp_fallback: EXP_AST_BASELINE = AST%_hat x ((MIN/48) x team FGM expected - own FGM expected) (no tracking needed)

stages.title: 0. MVP baseline (no tracking)
stages.note: Rate-based projection; the opportunity pipeline below must beat it in ablation.

stages.title: 1. Minutes
stages.note: Projected minutes.

stages.title: 2. Possessions
stages.note: On-court possessions.

stages.title: 3. Playmaking opportunities
stages.note: Potential assists = possessions x potential assists per possession, adjusted for competition and availability.

stages.title: 4. Teammate conversion
stages.note: Probability a creating pass is converted, given the receivers who are available.

stages.title: 5. Distribution
stages.note: Negative-binomial assists given overdispersed potential assists (NOT binomial: AST can exceed POTENTIAL_AST).

stages.title: 3. Three-point attempt rate
stages.note: Attempt volume with role and opponent adjustment.

stages.title: 4. Make probability
stages.note: Heavily shrunk; opponent 3P% allowed expected to add little.

stages.title: 5. Distribution
stages.note: Compound distribution: NB attempts, binomial makes.

stages.title: 2. Individual propensity
stages.note: Steals per 100 opponent possessions; deflections as a higher-count proxy.

stages.title: 3. Opponent turnover supply
stages.note: How often the opponent gives the ball away.

stages.title: 4. Distribution
stages.note: Zero-heavy count model.

stages.title: 2. Individual propensity
stages.note: Blocks per possession; rim attempts defended as the opportunity measure.

stages.title: 3. Opponent shot supply
stages.note: How many blockable shots the opponent takes.

stages.title: 4. Distribution
stages.note: Zero-heavy count model.

stages.title: 2. Individual propensity
stages.note: Turnovers per possession and per usage opportunity.

stages.title: 3. Usage change
stages.note: Turnovers move with usage when teammates are absent.

stages.title: 4. Opponent pressure
stages.note: Turnovers the opponent forces.

stages.title: 5. Distribution
stages.note: Count model.

COMBO.mvp_fallback: sum of component means with an empirical combined variance

stages.title: 1. Component distributions
stages.note: Each built by its own pipeline (baselines in the MVP; full opportunity pipelines optional).

stages.title: 2. Dependence
stages.note: Fitted on out-of-fold baseline residuals. Shared minutes and pace induce positive correlation; independent convolution understates variance.

stages.title: 3. Joint simulation
stages.note: Draw minutes and pace once per simulated game; draw all stats conditional on them; sum for PRA/PR/PA/RA/STOCKS.

features.formula: alpha_PTS = NB MLE of residuals y - mu_hat where mu_hat is the OUT-OF-FOLD forecast of the simple baseline MIN_ROLL x FRM_SHRUNK_RATE for this market (folds are chronological blocks inside the training window). features.leakage_notes: Leak-free only if every input is itself as-of the target date. Fit and evaluate with walk-forward splits; never random k-fold across dates. Parameter must be refit inside every walk-forward training window using out-of-fold residuals; a dispersion fit on the full history leaks future variance.
features.missing_data_handling: No prior history (rookies, returning from long absence) -> use archetype or draft-slot mean with maximum shrinkage; add is_low_sample flag.
features.validation_method: Calibration (PIT histogram / interval coverage) of the market distribution on a later chronological block.

features.name: Expected rebounds (MVP baseline, rate-based)
features.description: MVP rebound projection that needs no tracking data: the player's rebound share while on court times the rebounds available during his projected minutes. Uses the verified REB% identity rearranged.
features.formula: REB% = REB * TeamMIN / (MIN * (TmREB + OppREB))  (approximates the API REB_PCT; formula_checks.json reb_pct)  =>  E[REB] = REB%_hat * (E[MIN]/48) * TotalREB_exp, TotalREB_exp = a + b*misses_exp + c*FTA_exp with a,b,c re-fitted each season (2025-26 fit: 1.70, 0.873, 0.075; descriptive). The product of expectations ignores the covariance between minutes and the other terms - sample jointly. Distribution: NegBin(mean, alpha).
features.historical_availability: Verified for 2025-26 and 2026-27 (PlayerGameLogs/TeamGameLogs). Deeper history of these exact endpoints is UNTESTED; the underlying values are reproducible from box columns for any season where those exist.
features.pregame_availability: Yes - projection built pregame from lagged/pregame inputs
features.leakage_notes: Leak-free only if every input is itself as-of the target date. Fit and evaluate with walk-forward splits; never random k-fold across dates.
features.missing_data_handling: Fewer than N prior games -> shrink toward prior-season value, then position/archetype league mean (empirical-Bayes weight n/(n+k)); emit games_in_window as a companion feature.
features.validation_method: Compare with the opportunity-based EXP_REB_DIST (rebound chances x conversion) in ablation: is tracking worth its cost?
features.notes: Baseline for the REB pipeline. Assumes REB% is stable at the projected minutes and that the rebound supply relation holds out of sample.
